product.name: COGNNA Nexus Agentic AI SOC Platform
product.description: An AI-driven security operations platform that autonomously detects, analyzes, and responds to cyber threats in real-time to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate incident response.

product.name: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services
product.description: A 24/7 managed security service that provides continuous threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability assessment to protect organizations from cyberattacks.

identifier.value: Automated Asset Discovery and Vulnerability Management

product.name: Automated Asset Discovery and Vulnerability Management
product.description: A service that automatically identifies IT assets, uncovers shadow IT, detects visibility gaps, and performs vulnerability scanning to enhance security posture.

identifier.value: Threat Intelligence Integration and Cognitive Analytics

product.name: Threat Intelligence Integration and Cognitive Analytics
product.description: A platform feature that enriches security data with internal and external threat intelligence using cognitive analytics to improve threat validation and reduce false positives.

product.name: COGNNA Risk Score
product.description: A real-time assessment tool that evaluates an organization's security posture and provides tailored insights and recommendations.
